description: The Emergency Food Assistance Program (TEFAP) rules a food pantry follows in one US State or DC: income limit as a percent of the federal poverty guidelines, categorical eligibility, the eligibility form and how often the declaration is renewed, whether clients sign at each visit and e-signatures are allowed, proxy rules, what may not be required (ID, address, birth dates), record retention, civil-rights complaint forwarding and reporting. Each answer lists its sources (State agency and food bank publications) and the date they were verified. Free, no signup.

state.description: Two-letter State code or State name (50 States and DC).

name: tefap_rules
title: A State's TEFAP rules for food pantries
